guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：DDPM 擴散生成網路
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: DDPM diffusion-generation network
guides.concept: 以前向加噪、時間條件去噪與反向採樣解析DDPM 擴散生成網路：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
guides.conceptEn: Explore DDPM diffusion-generation network through forward noising, time-conditioned denoising and reverse sampling: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
procedure: 在「DDPM 擴散生成網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識clean sample與noise。DDPM前向邊際可寫x_t=√ᾱ_t x_0+√(1−ᾱ_t)ε；噪聲尺度隨時間條件而變。 建立前向加噪與邊際的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是前向加噪、時間條件去噪與反向採樣。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。手算指定ᾱ與ε的一維例，再核對均值方差。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

在「DDPM 擴散生成網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識time-conditioned U-Net。去噪網路需知道噪聲等級；噪聲預測loss与生成分布品質不是同一指標。 建立時間條件噪聲預測的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是前向加噪、時間條件去噪與反向採樣。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較相同帶噪輸入在兩種時間條件的預測及loss。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

在「DDPM 擴散生成網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識noise prediction gradient。反向生成是多步模型依赖過程；seed、排程與模型版本共同决定可重現邊界。 建立反向取樣與可重現性的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是前向加噪、時間條件去噪與反向採樣。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。保存假想seed、時間序列與版本，分開比較單步誤差及最終品質。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「DDPM 擴散生成網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識sampling步數與記憶。參數、啟動值及中間工作區都是記憶體負載；低參數數未必低算力需求。 建立運算量與記憶體的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是前向加噪、時間條件去噪與反向採樣。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。分開計數參數、activation及理想算術成本。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「DDPM 擴散生成網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識來源與權利切分。訓練與測試需按實際部署關係隔離；重複樣本或時間穿越可高估成績。 建立資料切分與洩漏的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是前向加噪、時間條件去噪與反向採樣。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。用羣組／時間切分比較隨機切分的假想結果。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「DDPM 擴散生成網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識生成品質與失效。平均指標可掩蓋少數類與分佈漂移；模型信心不等於正確率。 建立失效分析與泛化的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是前向加噪、時間條件去噪與反向採樣。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較分組誤差、校準與未見情境表現。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
procedureEn: Identify clean samples/noise in the mentor diagram and primary sources for DDPM diffusion-generation network. DDPM marginals use xt=sqrt(alpha_bar)x0+sqrt(1-alpha_bar)epsilon, with timestep-dependent noise scale. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of forward noising and marginals, focusing on forward noising, time-conditioned denoising and reverse sampling. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Hand-calculate a specified one-dimensional case and check mean/variance. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify time-conditioned u-net in the mentor diagram and primary sources for DDPM diffusion-generation network. Denoisers need noise-level conditions; noise-prediction loss differs from generated-distribution quality. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of time-conditioned noise prediction, focusing on forward noising, time-conditioned denoising and reverse sampling. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare predictions/loss for one noisy input under two time conditions. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify noise-prediction gradients in the mentor diagram and primary sources for DDPM diffusion-generation network. Reverse generation is a multistep model-dependent process; seeds, schedules and versions bound reproducibility. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of reverse sampling and reproducibility, focusing on forward noising, time-conditioned denoising and reverse sampling. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Record assumed seeds, schedules and versions; separate single-step errors from final quality. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify sampling steps/memory in the mentor diagram and primary sources for DDPM diffusion-generation network. Parameters, activations and workspace use memory; few parameters need not imply little compute. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of compute and memory, focusing on forward noising, time-conditioned denoising and reverse sampling. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Count parameters, activations and ideal arithmetic separately. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify source/rights splits in the mentor diagram and primary sources for DDPM diffusion-generation network. Splits should match deployment; duplicate examples and temporal leakage inflate scores. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of data splits and leakage, focusing on forward noising, time-conditioned denoising and reverse sampling. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare grouped/temporal and random splits on assumed results. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify generation quality/failures in the mentor diagram and primary sources for DDPM diffusion-generation network. Means hide minority classes and distribution shifts; confidence is not correctness. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of failure analysis and generalization, focusing on forward noising, time-conditioned denoising and reverse sampling. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare grouped errors, calibration and withheld scenarios. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

提交生成品質與失效的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
提交生成品質與失效的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
evidenceEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for source/rights splits.

related.title: U-Net 多尺度分割網路
related.why: 可遷移張量、數值誤差及計算／記憶體收支；算子、精度與資料歸納假設需重設。
related.whyEn: Tensor, numerical-error and compute/memory accounting transfer while operators, precision and data assumptions must be respecified.
related.transfer: 可遷移張量、數值誤差及計算／記憶體收支；算子、精度與資料歸納假設需重設。
related.transferEn: Tensor, numerical-error and compute/memory accounting transfer while operators, precision and data assumptions must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課針對前向加噪、時間條件去噪與反向採樣；U-Net 多尺度分割網路改以收縮、擴張、跳接與像素級驗收為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on forward noising, time-conditioned denoising and reverse sampling; U-Net multiscale segmentation network centers on contraction, expansion, skips and pixel-level validation, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照clean sample與noise與影像與像素標籤，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到U-Net 多尺度分割網路，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以生成品質與失效為起點，設計一項能區分「前向加噪、時間條件去噪與反向採樣」與「收縮、擴張、跳接與像素級驗收」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare clean samples/noise with images and pixel labels and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to U-Net multiscale segmentation network, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from generation quality/failures and propose an observation distinguishing forward noising, time-conditioned denoising and reverse sampling from contraction, expansion, skips and pixel-level validation, including uncertainty.
